messages.text: Good morning! Has anyone reviewed the latest deployment notes?
I reviewed them. The authentication changes look good, but we should test the token refresh flow.

attachments.title: AUTH-123: Test token refresh flow
attachments.text: Verify that expired access tokens are refreshed without interrupting active sessions.

messages.text: I can handle that test today and post the results in this channel.
Thanks! Please also check whether the refresh request is retried after a temporary network error.
The staging deployment is complete. Version 2.4.0 is now available for testing.
